safi-cedvel:16-17.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) is for transition (iḍrāb intiqālī) away from an implied statement, i.e. "you do not do that; rather you prefer ...". (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
Clause: «تؤثرون ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «الآخرة خير ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) «[Note: It may be resumptive, in which case it has no grammatical position.]».

safi-cedvel:18-19.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) of emphasis. (في الصحف) is attached to the khabar (predicate) of inna. (صحف) is a badal (substitute) for الصحف, genitive.
Clause: «إنّ هذا لفي الصحف» has no grammatical position (resumptive).

* Benefits:
- Some of what was in the Scrolls of Ibrāhīm and Mūsā, peace be upon them both:
On the authority of Abū Dharr, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: I entered the mosque, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The mosque has a greeting." I said: "And what is its greeting, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Two rakʿas that you pray." I said: "O Messenger of Allah, did Allah reveal to you anything of what was in the Scrolls of Ibrāhīm and Mūsā?" He said: "O Abū Dharr, recite: (قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّى. وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّى. بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَياةَ الدُّنْيا. وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقى.
إِنَّ هذا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولى. صُحُفِ إِبْراهِيمَ وَمُوسى)." I said: "O Messenger of Allah, what were the Scrolls of Mūsā?" He said: "They were all lessons: (I am amazed at one who is certain of death, how he can rejoice! I am amazed at one who is certain of the Fire, how he can laugh! I am amazed at one who sees the world and its turning against its people, how he can feel at ease! I am amazed at one who is certain of the divine decree, then exhausts himself in toil! I am amazed at one who is certain of the reckoning, then does not act!)." This hadith was recorded by Razīn in his book, and Ibn al-Athīr mentioned it in his book Jāmiʿ al-Uṣūl.
And al-Nasafī cited the saying: In the Scrolls of Ibrāhīm: (The intelligent person should guard his tongue, know his time, and attend to his own affairs).

safi-cedvel:1-5.t:
* I'rab:
(اسم) is a direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative «[Note: some exegetes made the word (اسم) redundant, but there is no need for that, for declaring the Name transcendent is declaring transcendent the One who owns the Name]». (الأعلى) is an naʿt (adjective) of ربّك, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra. (الذي) is a relative noun in the position of genitive as a second naʿt of ربّك; the two relative nouns that follow are conjoined to the first, in the position of genitive. (غثاء) is a second direct object, accusative. (أحوى) is an naʿt of غثاء, accusative «[Note: the word may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from المرعى — in the view of Abū l-Baqāʾ — i.e. "He brought out the herbage black, then made it dry chaff"]».
Clause: «سبّح ... » has no grammatical position (inceptive).
And the clause: «خلق ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي)).
And the clause: «سوّى ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause خلق).
And the clause: «قدّر ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the second relative noun (الذي)).
And the clause: «هدى ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause قدّر).
And the clause: «أخرج ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the third relative noun (الذي)).
And the clause: «جعله ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause أخرج).

* Morphology:
(5) أحوى: an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from حوي يحوى (the pattern of فرح), meaning "to be black with a touch of green". In al-Qāmūs: الحوّة (with ḍamma) is blackness tending to green, or redness tending to black; and حوي حوى is like رضي. The wazn of أحوى is أفعل, its feminine is حوّاء and its plural is حوّ (with ḍamma on the ḥāʾ and shadda on the wāw).

safi-cedvel:6-7.t:
* I'rab:
(السين) denotes the future. (الفاء) is a conjunction. (لا) is a negative particle «[Note: or, according to some, it is prohibitive, and the alif is redundant, a lengthening of the vowel of the sīn to suit the verse ending]»; the object of (تنسى) is omitted, i.e. "you will not forget what you recite". (إلّا) is for exception. (ما) is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted; the second (ما) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to الجهر.
Clause: «سنقرئك ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «لا تنسى ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause سنقرئك).
And the clause: «شاء الله ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (ما)).
And the clause: «إنّه يعلم ... » has no grammatical position (causal).
And the clause: «يعلم ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
And the clause: «يخفى» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the second relative noun (ما)).

* Morphology:
(تنسى): it contains a weakening by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb); the original is تنسي with a vowelled yāʾ at the end. The yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed into alif.
(يخفى): it contains a weakening by substitution; the original is يخفي with a vowelled yāʾ at the end. The yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed into alif.

safi-cedvel:8-13.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is a conjunction. (لليسرى) is attached to (نيسرك). (الفاء) links the apodosis of an implied condition. (نفعت) is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its tāʾ is vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two silent letters. (السين) denotes the future. (من) is a relative noun in the position of nominative as agent. (الذي) is in the position of nominative as an naʿt (adjective) of الأشقى. (ثمّ) is for conjunction. (لا) is negative in both places.
Clause: «نيسرك ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause نقرئك «[Note: in verse (6) of the sūra]»).
And the clause: «ذكّر ... » is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the reminder benefits the one who takes heed, then remind ...".
And the clause: «نفعت الذكرى ... » has no grammatical position (explicative of the implied protasis).
And the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
And the clause: «سيذّكر من يخشى ... » has no grammatical position (causal).
And the clause: «يخشى ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من)).
And the clause: «يتجنّبها ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause سيذّكر).
And the clause: «يصلى ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative noun (الذي)).
And the clause: «لا يموت ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يصلى).
And the clause: «لا يحيا» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause لا يموت).

* Morphology:
(8) اليسرى: feminine of الأيسر, meaning "the easier"; it is an elative (ism tafḍīl) from اليسر. The wazn of اليسرى is فعلى (with ḍamma).
(10) الأشقى: an elative from الشقاء; its wazn is أفعل. It contains a weakening by substitution; the original is الأشقي, the yāʾ was vowelled with a fatḥa before it and was changed into alif.
(13) يحيا: the alif is written long because it is not a proper name and is preceded by a yāʾ; in the muṣḥaf it is written with an undotted yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:14-15.t:
* I'rab:
(قد) is a particle of confirmation. (من) is a relative noun in the position of nominative as agent. (الواو) is a conjunction, and likewise (الفاء).
Clause: «أفلح من تزكّى ... » has no grammatical position (resumptive).
And the clause: «تزكّى ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من)).
And the clause: «ذكر ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause of the ṣila).
And the clause: «صلّى ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause ذكر).
